description: Read or write the script labels scripts use to find objects: get, set or clear an item's label, read or write a keyed label (insertLabel / extractLabel), or find the items whose label contains some text (Window > Utilities > Script Label)

key.description: For get and set: read or write the keyed label with this key instead of the Script Label text

label.description: For set: the label text; for find: text the label contains

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: manage_script_labels
title: Manage Script Labels
